desc: After the Consultant delivers Architecture Basic Design to the Client
Upon Client approval of full set of Architecture Basic Design Drawings and Documentation, ready for submission to Authority for approval.
Upon Authority’s approval of Basic Design or 6 months from the date the Client approves the Basic Design Documents for submission to Authority.
Upon Client approval of Fire Fighting Appraisal documents ready for submission to Authority for approval (Architecture part).
Upon Authority’s approval of Fire Fighting Appraisal documents or 6 months from the date the Client approves the Fire Fighting Documents for submission to Authority.
After the Consultant delivers Architecture Technical Design to the Client
Upon Client approval of full set of Architecture Technical Design Drawings and Documentation, ready for submission to Authority for Construction Permit.
Upon receipt Construction Permit or 6 months from the date the Client approves the Technical Design Documents for submission to Authority.

Upon the Client award Main contract package or 6 months from the date the Consultant submits tender documents to the Client. (The design documents used in the Tender stage will be the approved Technical design documents)
Upon the full set of Construction Design documents fully updated after Tender and issued for Construction
The Construction / Authorship supervision stage shall be paid to the Consultant by quartely (total 24 months construction from the Commencement date of Main Contract)
